title: The Third Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Confectionery: how to purify honey and sugar, candy oranges, citrons, peaches, walnuts, gourds and cherries, make quince paste, and mould a sugar paste into fruits and other dainties for the table.
